name: Creative Mode
description: Neo-brutalist editorial slide system on warm cream canvas with 4px ink borders, hard offset drop-shadows, and a bold four-color accent palette (forest green, hot pink, burnt orange, sunshine yellow). Archivo Black uppercase display at 0.92 line-height — aggressive, loud, zero letter-spacing softness. JetBrains Mono carries all metadata and labels. Space Grotesk handles body paragraphs. Every slide uses flat color-blocking with no gradients, no rounded cards (except the topbar pill), and no subtlety. Green fills the entire closing slide as a full-bleed impact move.
descriptionZh: 暖奶油色画布上的新野蛮主义编辑幻灯片系统。4px 墨水边框、硬偏移投影、大胆四色强调色板（森林绿、热粉、焦橙、阳光黄）。Archivo Black 大写展示字体，行高 0.92。JetBrains Mono 处理元数据和标签。Space Grotesk 处理正文。平面色块，无渐变、无圆角卡片（顶栏药丸除外）。绿色全出血用于结束页。
avoidFor: 需要制度克制和安静权威的场景
